description: Develop, review, and optimize idiomatic, memory-safe Rust code following the Rust API Guidelines. Use when writing Rust crates, managing ownership, borrowing, and lifetimes, designing robust traits and error hierarchies with Result/Option, configuring Clippy/rustfmt, choosing an edition or MSRV, or evaluating safe alternatives to unsafe code. Do not use for C/C++ FFI binding generation details, embedded no_std board bring-up, or general performance profiling unrelated to Rust language choices.
